sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是雷切尔·阿布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Earlier this week, the CDC released new guidelines which dramatically cut down the number of childhood vaccines recommended by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，美国疾控中心发布了新的指南，大幅削减了联邦政府推荐的儿童疫苗数量。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Benjamin Mueller and Apoorva Mondavili explain what's being cut, how this fits into the overall agenda from Health Secretary Robert F.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事本杰明·穆勒和阿普尔瓦·曼达维利将为我们解释哪些疫苗被砍掉了，这如何符合卫生部长小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., and the broader implications for public health.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪的整体议程，以及对公共健康的更广泛影响。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: Ben Apoorva, thank you both so much for being here today.
sentences.zh: 本，阿普尔瓦，非常感谢你们今天来到这里。

sentences.en: Glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: So ever since Robert F.
sentences.zh: 那么，自从小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪

sentences.en: was confirmed as the health secretary, there have been all kinds of questions about how he might seek to reshape public health policy,
sentences.zh: 被确认担任卫生部长以来，外界就一直在讨论他将如何试图重塑公共卫生政策，

sentences.en: particularly as it relates to vaccines, which he has been openly skeptical about for years.
sentences.zh: 特别是关于疫苗的政策，多年来他对此一直公开持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And this week, we saw some of the first major changes on that front.
sentences.zh: 而本周，我们看到了这方面的首批重大变化。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about the changes, why he made them, the implications for public health.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈这些变化、他做出这些决定的原因，以及对公共健康的影响。

sentences.en: But first, Apoorva, can you just explain to us what vaccines were affected?
sentences.zh: 但首先，阿普尔瓦，你能给我们解释一下有哪些疫苗受到了影响吗？

sentences.en: So before Monday, American children were supposed to routinely get vaccines for 17 diseases.
sentences.zh: 在周一之前，美国儿童按常规应该接种针对17种疾病的疫苗。

sentences.en: And on Monday, Secretary Kennedy and his associates, the other health officials, said that that vaccine schedule for children would be pared down so that now
sentences.zh: 而在周一，肯尼迪部长和他的同僚、其他卫生官员表示，儿童疫苗接种时间表将进行精简，因此现在

sentences.en: routine recommendation includes vaccination against 11 diseases.
sentences.zh: 常规推荐包括针对11种疾病的疫苗接种。

sentences.en: And which six were taken off?
sentences.zh: 哪六种被拿掉了？

sentences.en: So the six that are now being treated differently are respiratory syncytial virus,
sentences.zh: 现在受到不同对待的六种是呼吸道合胞病毒，

sentences.en: RSV, RSV, yes, rotavirus, hepatitis A and B, meningococcal vaccines, which are really for meningitis, and influenza.
sentences.zh: RSV，也就是RSV，轮状病毒，甲肝和乙肝，脑膜炎球菌疫苗（主要是针对脑膜炎），以及流感。

sentences.en: And I want to clarify here that when we say they were taken off, they are still on the recommendations.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里澄清一下，当我们说它们被“拿掉”时，它们其实依然在推荐名单上。

sentences.en: They're just recommended differently.
sentences.zh: 只是推荐的方式不同了。

sentences.en: So in theory, these vaccines are still all on the schedule, but they are now being recommended either for certain high-risk groups, or if you don't fall into one of those groups,
sentences.zh: 所以理论上，这些疫苗仍然全都在时间表上，但现在它们只被推荐用于某些高风险群体，或者如果你不属于这些群体，

sentences.en: that you should consult with your doctor first before getting them.
sentences.zh: 你在接种前应该先咨询医生。

sentences.en: So what it actually means in practice is that fewer people will get them, more people will be confused.
sentences.zh: 所以在实践中，这意味着更少的人会去接种，更多的人会感到困惑。

sentences.en: And the public health experts that I've been talking to feel that this will actually undermine
sentences.zh: 我一直在交流的公共卫生专家认为，这实际上会广泛地破坏

sentences.en: trust in vaccines in a very broad way, and people will start to think they're not really necessary at all.
sentences.zh: 人们对疫苗的信任，大家会开始觉得这些疫苗根本没有必要。

sentences.en: And Ben, can you tell us a little bit about what the argument is from Secretary Kennedy and the CDC for why this change was necessary and a good idea?
sentences.zh: 本，你能给我们讲讲肯尼迪部长和疾控中心的理由吗？他们为什么认为这种改变是必要的、也是个好主意？

sentences.en: Kennedy's been campaigning about the dangers of vaccines for years, and even Trump has sort of adopted that language about kids getting too many shots, with sort of vague reference
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪多年来一直在宣传疫苗的危险性，甚至特朗普也采纳了类似的说辞，称孩子们打的针太多了，并含糊地提及

sentences.en: to the dangers that that might hold for kids, dangers that doctors don't believe are actually reflected in the evidence.
sentences.zh: 这可能给孩子带来的危险——医生们并不认为这些危险在科学证据中有所体现。

sentences.en: In this case, Kennedy has sort of taken Denmark as his model, a country that has a much more
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上，肯尼迪将丹麦作为他的榜样，该国的

sentences.en: minimal vaccine schedule than the United States, a much smaller country with a very different health system.
sentences.zh: 疫苗时间表比美国精简得多，那是一个医疗系统非常不同的小得多的国家。

sentences.en: And the idea there seems to be that they want to refashion the American vaccine program to sort of fit a much more pared down schedule, so it no longer tries to address all of the
sentences.zh: 他们的想法似乎是想重塑美国的疫苗计划，使其符合一个精简得多的时间表，这样它就不再试图解决美国医疗系统的

sentences.en: problems and fallibilities with the American health system, all the medical needs of the
sentences.zh: 所有问题和漏洞，不再满足美国人口的所有医疗需求，

sentences.en: American population, and instead say, you know, there should be a new system that's much
sentences.zh: 而是转而认为，应该建立一个更加

sentences.en: more individualistic, where each kid is consulted on their particular needs and the particular advice of their doctor, rather than a sort of one-size-fits-all, let's decide what's
sentences.zh: 个人主义的新系统，每个孩子都要根据其特定需求和医生的具体建议来接种，而不是搞那种“一刀切”、由我们来决定什么对

sentences.en: best for the health of the American population generally.
sentences.zh: 美国大众整体健康最好的模式。

sentences.en: That seems to be a little bit of what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的情况似乎有点类似于此。

sentences.en: It feels very spiritually connected to this idea that we've heard from Kennedy before about people should have autonomy with their own bodies, their own health.
sentences.zh: 这在精神内核上，与我们以前听过的肯尼迪的观点非常契合，即人们应该对自己身体和健康拥有自主权。

sentences.en: They should be able to make their own choices, right?
sentences.zh: 他们应该能够做出自己的选择，对吧？

sentences.en: Right, and this sort of resistance to collective thinking about the collective health of Americans, they brand themselves as a medical freedom movement.
sentences.zh: 没错，这种对关乎美国大众集体健康的集体思维的抗拒，他们将自己包装成一个医疗自由运动。

sentences.en: I mean, in this case, the vaccine schedule does not itself mandate the taking of these shots.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就这个决定本身而言，疫苗接种时间表并没有强制要求注射这些疫苗。

sentences.en: That's happening at the state level, so Kennedy hasn't actually sort of, in practice, freed anybody from onerous obligations to take this or that shot with this decision itself.
sentences.zh: 这是在州层面实施的，所以肯尼迪的这个决定实际上并没有在实践中把任何人从必须接种某针的繁重义务中解放出来。

sentences.en: But yes, they are trying to make this a much more case-by-case, you talk to your doctor and you have the power to decide what shots your kid should be taking.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，他们确实在试图将其变成一个更加具体情况具体分析的事情：你跟医生沟通，然后你有权力决定你的孩子该打什么针。

sentences.en: Can I just ask a question about that, though?
sentences.zh: 我能就此问个问题吗？

sentences.en: Because we all know how rushed some doctors are, how little time medical professionals have.
sentences.zh: 因为我们都知道有些医生有多忙，医疗专业人员的时间有多有限。

sentences.en: And I feel like one of the criticisms or pushback to that that you hear from people that are
sentences.zh: 我觉得对疫苗持怀疑态度的人所提出的批评或反对意见之一就是：在实际操作中，我根本没有去读信息表。

sentences.en: skeptical of vaccines is that, well, in practice, I'm not reading the information sheet.
sentences.zh: 根本没人给我信息表。

sentences.en: I'm not giving the information sheet.
sentences.zh: 医生也不会跟我过一遍风险。

sentences.en: The doctor's not going over the risks with me.
sentences.zh: 对这种说法有什么回应吗？

sentences.en: What is the response to that idea?
sentences.zh: 这是一个合理的观点。

sentences.en: But that's a fair point.
sentences.zh: 医生确实不一定总是有时间把这些事情过一遍。

sentences.en: Doctors don't necessarily always have time to go through these things.
sentences.zh: 但我们的想法是，如果家长确实有问题，这就是他们可以进行交流的途径。

sentences.en: But the idea is that if parents do have questions, this is how they can talk about it.
sentences.zh: 有一个这样的平台。

sentences.en: There is a forum for that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们担心医生没有足够的时间跟家长沟通所有的担忧，

sentences.en: And if we are worried about doctors not having enough time to talk parents through all of
sentences.zh: 那么我们刚刚把这个问题放大了四倍，因为我们在名单上塞了一大堆疫苗，

sentences.en: the concerns, well, we've just quadrupled that problem by putting a whole bunch of vaccines
sentences.zh: 家长现在必须跟儿科医生好好讨论这些疫苗。

sentences.en: on the list that parents are now going to have to really talk about with their pediatricians.
sentences.zh: 甚至在打针之前就要讨论。

sentences.en: Before they can even get the shot.
sentences.zh: 我还想说，将疫苗列入推荐注射名单的决定，在历史上从来都不是轻率做出的。

sentences.en: I would also say the decision to put vaccines on this recommended slate of shots has not historically been taken lightly.
sentences.zh: 它是在与医生、公众代表和专业团体协商后做出的。

sentences.en: It's happened after a consultation with doctors, members of the public, professional groups.
sentences.zh: 这些推荐意见已经渗透到了医疗实践中。

sentences.en: And those recommendations have filtered down into medical practice.
sentences.zh: 它们之所以能被采纳，是因为它们经过了相当广泛的研究，并被确定为安全有效的。

sentences.en: And to the extent they've been adopted, they've been adopted because they were studied pretty extensively and determined to be safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 因此，那些大概花了很多时间思考、研究、撰写和探讨疫苗安全性的人——

sentences.en: And so the people that presumably have spent a lot of time thinking, studying, writing, researching the safety of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 医疗和科学界对这些变化有何反应？

sentences.en: How are the medical and scientific communities responding to these changes?
sentences.zh: 他们大致分成了两个阵营。

sentences.en: They've been sort of broadly falling into two camps.
sentences.zh: 可以说，我交谈过的很多人都持乐观态度，希望儿科医生和

sentences.en: I'd say I've talked to a lot of people who are optimistic, hoping that pediatricians and
sentences.zh: 家长们能够真正认识到疫苗的价值，并且当真正面临抉择时，人们会像往常一样继续生活，不会有什么大变化。

sentences.en: parents really recognize the value of vaccines and that when it really comes down to it, people will continue to go on as they always have and nothing much will change.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，专家们则真心感到非常担忧，因为他们已经看到有些家长走进诊所说：我听到风声说政府认为

sentences.en: And then on the other side are experts who are genuinely really worried because they are already seeing some parents coming in saying, what I'm hearing is the government is saying
sentences.zh: 这些疫苗已经不需要了。

sentences.en: these vaccines are not needed anymore.
sentences.zh: 那我真的还需要打这一针吗？

sentences.en: And do I even really need to get this one?
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And I don't know.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像太多了，等等。

sentences.en: It seems like too much, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 但几乎所有人都同意，这造成了极大的混乱，而在公共卫生领域，混乱绝不是什么好事。

sentences.en: But pretty much all of them agree that this is creating a lot of confusion and that confusion is never good when it comes to public health.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里有一个非常快、也很有意思的现象值得注意：他们一直在谈论丹麦，而做出最多疫苗安全研究的人

sentences.en: One really quick, I think, interesting thing to note here is that they've been talking a lot about Denmark and the person who has done probably the most work on vaccine safety
sentences.zh: 就在丹麦。

sentences.en: is in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 他是丹麦疾控中心的一员，我已经和他交谈过几次了，他对这些决定感到非常困惑，不明白为什么美国

sentences.en: He's part of Denmark's CDC and I've spoken to him a few times now and he is just baffled by these decisions and does not understand why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 要这么做。

sentences.en: is doing this.
sentences.zh: 等等，解释一下，为什么美国

sentences.en: Wait, just to explain that, why would it be so baffling that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 想要效仿

sentences.en: would want to emulate
sentences.zh: 丹麦会让人觉得如此困惑？

sentences.en: Denmark?
sentences.zh: 丹麦是一个微型国家，拥有无可挑剔的医疗保健、免费的产前护理，以及对孕妇极佳的筛查。

sentences.en: Denmark is a tiny country with impeccable health care, free prenatal care, really excellent screening of pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 他们决定不打那么多针。

sentences.en: They have decided not to have quite as many shots.
sentences.zh: 他们只有10种。

sentences.en: They have 10.
sentences.zh: 放眼全球，他们确实是个特例。

sentences.en: They're really the outlier when we talk about the world.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做是因为他们必须采购大量疫苗。

sentences.en: And they've done that because they have to purchase a lot of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 对于这么一个面积很小的国家来说，疾病负担有时无法让这些疫苗显得那么具有成本效益。

sentences.en: And for such a small country, sometimes the burden of disease doesn't make those vaccines quite as cost effective.
sentences.zh: 所以这其实是一个经济决定。

sentences.en: So it's really an economic decision.
sentences.zh: 但在美国，我们没有那种严格的后续追踪和免费医疗，无法承担让孩子不接种疫苗、万一病了的后果。

sentences.en: But in the United States, we don't have the kind of rigorous follow-up and free care that would make it OK for a kid to not be vaccinated and maybe get sick.
sentences.zh: 因为在丹麦，生病的儿童会立刻得到看诊和治疗，家长只需支付零费用或极少费用。

sentences.en: Because in Denmark, that kid would get seen right away, get treated right away at zero or very little cost to the parents.
sentences.zh: 然而在这里，预防才是真正的最佳选择。

sentences.en: Whereas here, prevention is really the best option.
sentences.zh: 显然，所有这些被移出时间表的疫苗，它们的作用各不相同。

sentences.en: Obviously, all of these vaccines that are coming off the schedule, they all do different things.
sentences.zh: 它们有着不同的背景故事。

sentences.en: They have different backstories.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道我们是否可以挑出其中一个来重点讲讲，这或许能帮我们解释我们是如何走到这一步的。

sentences.en: But I wonder if we can pick one to focus on that might help us explain sort of how we got to this point.
sentences.zh: 比如，你可以跟我讲讲某种特定的疫苗是如何被加入儿童疫苗时间表、随后又如何成为靶子的吗？

sentences.en: Like, maybe you can tell me about how a particular vaccine got added to the childhood vaccine schedule and then later became a target.
sentences.zh: 我觉得乙肝就是一个非常有趣的例子。

sentences.en: I think hepatitis B is a really interesting example here.
sentences.zh: 这是一种高度传染性的病毒，可能非常危险，它会感染肝脏，并通过血液和其他体液传播。

sentences.en: This is a virus that is highly contagious, can be very dangerous, it infects the liver, and it spreads through blood and other bodily fluids.
sentences.zh: 因此，在20世纪80年代初经过多年的努力后，科学家们终于研发出了一种疫苗。

sentences.en: So finally, after years of work in the early 1980s, scientists develop a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 它高效且安全，联邦卫生官员决定将其推荐给他们认为

sentences.en: It's highly effective, it's safe, and federal health officials decide to recommend it to groups
sentences.zh: 感染该病毒风险较高的群体，例如静脉吸毒者和男男性行为者。

sentences.en: that they deem to be at high risk for the virus, which is intravenous drug users and men who have sex with men, for example.
sentences.zh: 外界曾抱有很大希望，认为他们终于能够扭转这种病毒的蔓延势头了。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of optimism that they're finally going to turn back the tide of this virus.
sentences.zh: 但结果却恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Instead, the opposite happens.
sentences.zh: 乙肝病例持续攀升。

sentences.en: Cases of hepatitis B keep climbing.
sentences.zh: 数十万人遭到感染。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of people are getting infected.
sentences.zh: 我想，从这个故事中我们可以看出最初那个疫苗接种策略存在哪些漏洞。

sentences.en: And I think in that story, we learn about what some of the holes were in that initial vaccination strategy.
sentences.zh: 是什么漏洞？

sentences.en: Which were?
sentences.zh: 嗯，最初那个疫苗接种策略的一个问题是，事实证明医生们并不善于识别哪些患者最适合接种这种疫苗。

sentences.en: Well, so one problem with that first vaccination strategy was that doctors turned out not to be very good at identifying which patients would be well served by the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 其中一些患者要么不知道自己应该去打针，要么因为害怕疫苗而产生抵触情绪。

sentences.en: And some of those very patients either didn't know that they should get the shot or were resistant to getting it because they were afraid of the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 那是一种新疫苗。

sentences.en: It was a new vaccine.
sentences.zh: 当时流传着一些虚假谣言，称它可能会传播艾滋病毒。

sentences.en: There were sort of false rumors spreading that it might be causing HIV.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题是，医生们并不总是能识别出这种病毒实际上正在哪些患者群体中传播。

sentences.en: There was also a second problem, which is that doctors didn't always recognize in what patient populations this virus was, in fact, spreading.
sentences.zh: 这其中就包括儿童，许多儿童都受到了感染，其中一些人在几年后因这种病毒而面临健康问题。

sentences.en: That included kids, many of whom were getting infected, some of whom were facing health problems years down the road from this virus.

sentences.en: So, Apoorva, you said earlier that theoretically these vaccines will still be available to the people that want them.

sentences.en: But obviously, these guidelines are changing.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这些指南正在改变。

sentences.en: I can imagine that if you are a parent who wants a vaccine for your child, this is all very confusing.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象，如果你是一个想为孩子接种疫苗的家长，这一切都会非常令人困惑。

sentences.en: How are people supposed to navigate this?
sentences.zh: 人们该如何应对这种情况？

sentences.en: I think it's very important to know, first of all, that for parents who really want vaccines for their kids, insurance will still cover the costs.
sentences.zh: 我认为首先非常重要的一点是要知道，对于真正希望孩子接种疫苗的家长来说，保险仍然会承担费用。

sentences.en: They will not have to pay out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 他们不必自掏腰包。

sentences.en: And they can find pediatricians who will give them the shots.
sentences.zh: 他们可以找到会为孩子注射疫苗的儿科医生。

sentences.en: This idea of shared clinical decision making is what became really important in this new schedule.
sentences.zh: 这种“共同临床决策”的理念在这个新时间表中变得非常重要。

sentences.en: Talk to your doctor firSt.
sentences.zh: 先和你的医生谈谈。

sentences.en: So on a very practical level, the new guidelines won't change much for parents who want the vaccines and pediatricians who are administering them.
sentences.zh: 所以在非常实际的层面，新指南对于想接种疫苗的家长和负责施打的儿科医生来说，并没有太大改变。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If pediatricians already wanted to give the vaccine, that should not change.
sentences.zh: 如果儿科医生本来就想提供疫苗，这一点不应该改变。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Even if you're not in a high-risk group, you should be able to get a vaccine that theoretically is only for high-risk groups.
sentences.zh: 即使你不在高风险群体中，你也应该能够获得理论上仅适用于高风险群体的疫苗。

sentences.en: Where I think we're really going to see changes is at the individual level, where individual parents are confused and not sure what to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们真正会看到变化的地方是在个人层面上，个别家长会感到困惑，不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: And pediatricians may run out of time to counsel their patients on what to do.
sentences.zh: 而儿科医生可能没有时间就该怎么做对患者进行咨询。

sentences.en: I think that's where things are really going to start to fray.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是事情真正开始出现裂痕的地方。

sentences.en: And then, you know, in terms of mandates, which is really where rubber hits the road for vaccines, every state has requirements for children to enter daycare or kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，就强制令而言——这才是疫苗政策真正触及核心的地方——每个州都有儿童进入日托或幼儿园的要求。

sentences.en: And those are actually very similar across states, blue and red, very few differences.
sentences.zh: 而且这些要求在各州之间实际上非常相似，无论是蓝州还是红州，几乎没有什么区别。

sentences.en: And so far, at least, it seems like that may not change either.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，至少看起来这可能也不会改变。

sentences.en: I was speaking with a New York State Health Commissioner who's been having a lot of conversations with his colleagues in both red and blue states.
sentences.zh: 我曾与纽约州卫生专员交谈过，他一直在与红州和蓝州的同事们进行大量对话。

sentences.en: And he was saying that nobody really wants to change anything.
sentences.zh: 他说没有人真的想改变任何事情。

sentences.en: So unless their governors intervene, I think things will stay as they are.
sentences.zh: 因此，除非他们的州长进行干预，否则我认为事情会保持原样。

sentences.en: So but theoretically, a state governor could say, OK, the CDC is now recommending that these six vaccines come off the schedule.
sentences.zh: 所以，从理论上讲，一个州的州长可以说：“好吧，疾控中心现在建议将这六种疫苗从时间表中移除。

sentences.en: I want to see changes in my state and I will direct my state health department to change the requirements for, let's say, the vaccines you need for preschool.
sentences.zh: 我想看到我的州发生变化，我将指示我的州卫生部门更改要求，比如针对学前班所需的疫苗。”

sentences.en: And if that were to happen, explain what happens next.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，请解释接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: What happens is they will probably have a fight on their hands because vaccines, even with all of the anti-vaccine sentiments you hear, are still really popular with most people.
sentences.zh: 发生的情况是，他们可能会面临一场硬仗，因为尽管听到各种反疫苗情绪，疫苗在大多数人中仍然非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: There's strong bipartisan support for childhood vaccination.
sentences.zh: 两党对儿童疫苗接种都有强有力的支持。

sentences.en: And in states where people have proposed making changes, it has not always gone well.
sentences.zh: 在一些人提议做出改变的州，结果并不总是很顺利。

sentences.en: OK, so it sounds like even if things do not change for the time being at the state level,
sentences.zh: 好的，听起来即使州一级的情况暂时没有改变，

sentences.en: as you were saying, Apoorva, practically speaking, fewer kids are going to get this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，阿普尔瓦，从实际角度来看，将会有更少的孩子接种这种疫苗。

sentences.en: Either it's because the clinicians don't have time to go over the risks, parents are confused or perhaps other reasons.
sentences.zh: 要么是因为临床医生没有时间讲解风险，家长感到困惑，或者可能是其他原因。

sentences.en: And so therefore, we can expect that there will be more illness of some amount in this country.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可以预料这个国家的某种疾病发病率会上升。

sentences.en: And I wonder if we have any sense of the scale of that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们是否对这种规模有所感知。

sentences.en: Well, we have some idea for some of the diseases, right, from before the vaccines were in routine use.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于某些疾病，我们从疫苗常规使用之前的情况中确实有一些概念，对吧？

sentences.en: So if you think about something like rotavirus, before the vaccine was in routine use, there were something like 70,000 hospitalizations in kids a year.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想想轮状病毒之类的疾病，在疫苗常规使用之前，每年大约有7万名儿童住院。

sentences.en: And that's the worst case scenario.
sentences.zh: 那是域值的最坏情况。

sentences.en: But also it's important to remember we're a big country with a big population.
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是要记住，我们是一个拥有庞大人口的大国。

sentences.en: So even a small drop in vaccination rates, which we have already seen in this country, results in quite a few cases.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使疫苗接种率出现微小的下降——我们在国内已经看到了这一点——也会导致相当数量的病例。

sentences.en: You know, we're seeing that unfold now with measles, for example.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们现在正看着这种情况在麻疹身上上演，例如。

sentences.en: The vaccination rate for measles has fallen by something like two percentage points.
sentences.zh: 麻疹的疫苗接种率已经下降了大约两个百分点。

sentences.en: But this year, we've had more cases than in the mid-1990s.
sentences.zh: 但今年，我们的病例比20世纪90年代中期还要多。

sentences.en: And it's fallen, by the way, because of public messaging, not necessarily because of vaccine changes.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，接种率下降是因为公共信息传达的问题，而不一定是由于疫苗本身的变化。

sentences.en: Measles, I should note, is still on the schedule.
sentences.zh: 我需要指出的是，麻疹仍然在时间表上。

sentences.en: It is on the schedule.
sentences.zh: 它确实在时间表上。

sentences.en: And the reason it fell is a combination of a couple of different things.
sentences.zh: 它之所以下降，是几种不同因素共同作用的结果。

sentences.en: It started to fall during the pandemic because of sort of infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 它在疫情期间开始下降，原因是某种基础设施问题。

sentences.en: You know, clinics were closed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，诊所关门了。

sentences.en: People couldn't get to the clinics.
sentences.zh: 人们去不了诊所。

sentences.en: And then also, yeah, the combination of sort of rising anti-vaccine sentiment.
sentences.zh: 然后还有，嗯，反疫苗情绪高涨等因素的结合。

sentences.en: And that certainly got worse this last year.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，这种情况肯定变得更加严重。

sentences.en: And at the end of this month, we are most likely going to lose our status for measles elimination in this country.
sentences.zh: 在本月底，我们很有可能会失去在这个国家消除麻疹的地位。

sentences.en: So the United States will no longer be considered to have eliminated measles.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国将不再被认为已经消除了麻疹。

sentences.en: There's this idea, I think, that healthy children will somehow be sort of excluded from
sentences.zh: 我认为存在这样一种观点，即健康的儿童不知何故会被排除在

sentences.en: these consequences, protected from these consequences, that the rising tide of illnesses like measles
sentences.zh: 这些后果之外，免受这些后果的影响，认为像麻疹这样的疾病死灰复燃

sentences.en: will sort of only or predominantly affect sick kids with weakened immune systeMs.
sentences.zh: 将只影响或主要影响免疫系统受损的生病儿童。

sentences.en: And that's just not been true.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: I think it's been part of the sort of Kennedy and Kennedy-aligned thinking on what might happen in a country with fewer vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我认为这构成了肯尼迪及与肯尼迪立场一致的人对于在疫苗较少的国家可能发生的情况的思考的一部分。

sentences.en: But what we've seen is that healthy children, too, have been stricken with these viruses and gotten very sick from them.
sentences.zh: 但我们看到的是，健康的儿童同样被这些病毒击倒，并因此病得很重。

sentences.en: We've seen, for example, in the last couple winters that the seasonal flu has exacted a really high toll on American children.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们在过去几个冬天看到，季节性流感给美国儿童造成了非常沉重的代价。

sentences.en: Hundreds of kids died last winter from the flu, which was the highest toll in more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天有数百名儿童死于流感，这是十多年来最高的人数。

sentences.en: This year's flu is, again, a really devastating virus.
sentences.zh: 今年的流感再次成为一种极具破坏性的病毒。

sentences.en: And so the consequences of lower vaccination rates, we're already seeing them play out among
sentences.zh: 因此，较低疫苗接种率带来的后果，我们已经看到它们在

sentences.en: American children.
sentences.zh: 美国儿童中间上演。

sentences.en: And there's one other giant thing that is really weighing on the minds of some of the public health experts that I've been talking to, which is the vaccine liability protection
sentences.zh: 还有一件大事深深压在与我交谈过的一些公共卫生专家的心头，那就是我们国家拥有的
